meta.forecast_period_note: forecast_* の対象期間は四半期で異なります。各レコードの quarter で判別してください。Q1-Q3 の forecast_* は当期通期見通し、Q4(本決算) の forecast_* は翌期(翌事業年度)通期見通しです。Q1-Q3 の actual_* は累計(YTD)のため、actual÷forecast は『通期予想に対する進捗率』として意味を持ちますが、予想比・達成率・サプライズではありません。Q4 は actual=当期実績・forecast=翌期予想で対象年度が異なるため、actual÷forecast は構造的に無意味です。

data.edinet_filing_url_note: This filing is more than approximately 9.5 years old. EDINET retains original filing documents (the page linked by edinet_filing_url) for roughly 10 years on a rolling basis, so this link may return a 規定外操作 (invalid operation) error if the filing has aged out of that window.

data_notes: ordinary_income, non_operating_income, non_operating_expenses, extraordinary_income, and extraordinary_loss are null for IFRS/US GAAP companies because these are JP-GAAP-specific P/L stages with no equivalent disclosure category in IFRS/US GAAP filings. Null does not mean zero.

ordinary_income may exceptionally be non-null for IFRS/US GAAP companies when the original XBRL discloses a genuine consolidated ordinary income figure, e.g. dual disclosure in the transition year to IFRS.
dividend_per_share: EDINET does not retroactively adjust DPS for stock splits. Historical values may appear inflated for companies that have performed splits.
payout_ratio: Values exceeding 200% are set to null to exclude anomalous cases (special dividends, unadjusted stock splits).
